```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

The purpose of this document is to run the baseline Malawi model to see how 
badly it is affected by the ResultsScaleFactor. Robyn S found that it was
apparently too small by a factor of 1000.

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(data.table))
library(magrittr)
devtools::install_github("BershteynLab/EMODAnalyzeR", force = TRUE)
```


# Baseline data

```{r}
input_path = "/gpfs/scratch/citrod01/experiments/Malawi/Baseline-campaign_Malawi_20251215-demo_test_baseline___2026_11_05_15_35_04_472636"

sim.baseline <- EMODAnalyzeR::read.simulation.results.bigpurple(
  experiment_path = input_path,
  scenario_name = 'baseline',
  summarize_columns = c("Newly.Infected", "Newly.Tested.Positive", "Newly.Tested.Negative",
                        "Population","Infected", "On_ART","Died", "Died_from_HIV",
                        "Tested.Past.Year.or.On_ART", "Tested.Ever","Diagnosed" ),
  stratify_columns = c("Year", "Gender", "Age"),
  min_age_inclusive = 0,
  max_age_inclusive = 99
) %>% 
  ungroup()


input_path = "/gpfs/scratch/citrod01/experiments/Malawi/Baseline-campaign_Malawi_20251215-demo_test_1000___2026_11_05_16_06_33_142433"

sim.demo <- EMODAnalyzeR::read.simulation.results.bigpurple(
  experiment_path = input_path,
  scenario_name = 'demo',
  summarize_columns = c("Newly.Infected", "Newly.Tested.Positive", "Newly.Tested.Negative",
                        "Population","Infected", "On_ART","Died", "Died_from_HIV",
                        "Tested.Past.Year.or.On_ART", "Tested.Ever","Diagnosed" ),
  stratify_columns = c("Year", "Gender", "Age"),
  min_age_inclusive = 0,
  max_age_inclusive = 99
) %>% 
  ungroup()

sim.results <- rbind(sim.baseline, sim.demo)

CENSUS_YEAR = 2018.5
MALAWI_CENSUS_POP = 17563749

sim.results.pop.scaling <- sim.results %>% 
      filter(Year == CENSUS_YEAR) %>%
      group_by(sim.id) %>%
      summarize(total.pop = sum(Population), .groups = 'keep') %>% 
      mutate(pop.scaling.factor = MALAWI_CENSUS_POP/total.pop)

sim.results <- sim.results %>% 
  inner_join(
    sim.results.pop.scaling,
    by = c("sim.id")
  )

```

# Plot Metrics without rescaling

Looks as though population is just 1/2 what it should be.

```{r}
plot <- sim.results %>% 
  group_by(sim.ix, scenario_name, Year) %>% 
  summarize(Population = sum(Population),
            Died = sum(Died),
            Infected = sum(Infected),
            Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV),
            Diagnosed = sum(Diagnosed),
            On_ART = sum(On_ART)
            ) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, Year) %>% 
  summarize(Population = mean(Population),
            Died = mean(Died),
            Infected = mean(Infected),
            Died_from_HIV = mean(Died_from_HIV),
            Diagnosed = mean(Diagnosed), 
            On_ART = mean(On_ART)
            ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Population, Died, Infected, Died_from_HIV, Diagnosed, On_ART), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_point(
    mapping = aes(x = Year, y = Value, color = scenario_name) 
  ) + facet_wrap(~ Metric, scales = 'free_y', nrow = 2, ncol = 3)

ggsave(filename = "/gpfs/data/bershteynlab/EMOD/citrod01/hivsim_paper/models/emod/original/Analysis/demo_plot.pdf",
       width = 12,
       height = 8,
       units = 'in')

```


# Plot metrics with pop scale factor rescaling

```{r}
plot <- sim.results %>% 
  group_by(sim.ix, scenario_name, Year) %>% 
  summarize(Population = sum(Population * pop.scaling.factor),
            Died = sum(Died * pop.scaling.factor),
            Infected = sum(Infected * pop.scaling.factor),
            Died_from_HIV = sum(Died_from_HIV * pop.scaling.factor),
            Diagnosed = sum(Diagnosed * pop.scaling.factor),
            On_ART = sum(On_ART * pop.scaling.factor)
            ) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, Year) %>% 
  summarize(Population = mean(Population),
            Died = mean(Died),
            Infected = mean(Infected),
            Died_from_HIV = mean(Died_from_HIV),
            Diagnosed = mean(Diagnosed), 
            On_ART = mean(On_ART)
            ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Population, Died, Infected, Died_from_HIV, Diagnosed, On_ART), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_point(
    mapping = aes(x = Year, y = Value, color = scenario_name) 
  ) + facet_wrap(~ Metric, scales = 'free_y', nrow = 2, ncol = 3)

ggsave(filename = "/gpfs/data/bershteynlab/EMOD/citrod01/hivsim_paper/models/emod/original/Analysis/demo_plot_rescaled.pdf",
       width = 12,
       height = 8,
       units = 'in')

```

## See whether the disagreements over baseline mortality rate affects the calibration significantly

```{r}
#age_bins = c(15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55, 60, 65,99)
age_bins = c(15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 55, 60)
subset_years = c(2004, 2010, 2015.5)

# Subset data on years
data <- sim.results %>% filter(Year %in% subset_years)

# Age bins
age_labels = c()
for (i in 1:(length(age_bins) - 1)){
  age_labels <- append(age_labels, paste0("[",age_bins[i],":",age_bins[i + 1],")"))
}

# Label each age by its bin
data <- data %>% mutate(
  AgeBin = cut(Age, breaks = age_bins, right = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(AgeBin))

data$AgeBin_index = factor(data$AgeBin,
                           levels = levels(data$AgeBin),
                           labels = 1:length(age_labels))

# Calculate prevalence, grouping by age bin
data.prev <- data %>% EMODAnalyzeR::calculate.prevalence(
  stratify_columns = c("Year", "AgeBin_index", "AgeBin", "Gender", "scenario_name", "sim.id"),
  numerator = "Infected",
  denominator = "Population")

# Calculate mean prevalence across all sim runs
ageprev.data.mean <- data.prev %>%
  dplyr::group_by(Year, AgeBin_index, AgeBin, Gender, scenario_name) %>%
  dplyr::summarize(mean.Prevalence = mean(Prevalence),
            sd.Prevalence = sd(Prevalence),
            .groups = 'keep') %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(upper = mean.Prevalence + 2*sd.Prevalence,
                lower = case_when(mean.Prevalence - 2 * sd.Prevalence > 0 ~ mean.Prevalence - 2 * sd.Prevalence,
                         mean.Prevalence - 2 * sd.Prevalence <= 0 ~ 0)
                )

# Transform data
ageprev.data.mean <- ageprev.data.mean %>% mutate(Gender = case_when(Gender==0 ~ "Male", Gender==1 ~ "Female"))
ageprev.data.mean <- ageprev.data.mean[order(ageprev.data.mean$scenario_name), ]
ageprev.data.mean$scenario_name <- as.factor(ageprev.data.mean$scenario_name)
```

```{r}
ageprev.data.mean %>% 
  filter(AgeBin_index %in% c(1,2,3,4,5))%>% 
  arrange(scenario_name, Gender, Year)
```

sim.results %>% 
  filter(Age >= 35) %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, sim.ix, Year, Gender, IP_Key.ARTStatus) %>% 
  summarize(
    Infected = sum(Infected * pop.scaling.factor),
    Died_from_HIV = Died_from_HIV * pop.scaling.factor, .groups = 'drop_last') %>% 
  group_by(scenario_name, Year, Gender, IP_Key.ARTStatus) %>% 
  summarize(
    Infected = mean(Infected),
    Died_from_HIV = mean(Died_from_HIV), .groups = 'drop_last') %>% 
  mutate(mort = Died_from_HIV/Infected)
